title: Father, Hear Us When We Pray
description: Father, Hear Us When We Pray in Tonic Solfa to ST. BEES, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 904 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “For a Prayer Meeting”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Sevens (7.7.7.7), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST. BEES; any other Sevens tune fits them as well.
underlay: Fa-ther, hear us when we pray, Look in mer-cy from a-bove; Turn not, Lord, thy face a-way, Hear, and grant thy par-doning love.

lines: Father, hear us when we pray,
Turn not, Lord, thy face away,
Hear, and grant thy pardoning love.
In the name of Christ we come,
Raise our hearts to heaven, our home,
Pure and holy may we be,
From all hate and envy free,
Let our souls to thee aspire.
While we love the Saviour's name,
And his words with zeal obey,
His sweet promise we may claim; —
"He will meet us when we pray."

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST. BEES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
